title: Kati Keef delivers an anthem for the hustlers and dreamers on the new song "Woke up in a Blendr"
htmlContent:
American-based lyrical genius Kali Keef is a multi-talented poetic genius who has taken the time to learn all he needs to know about his craft. The superstar fully displays his talent in his recent song "Woke up in a Blendr."

In his recent single "Woke up in a Blendr," Kali Keef” is that music that will forever make music fun and fresh to enjoy. The artist's aspirational vibes in the music shine to the fullest and deliver a hit that you listen to, and when it's done, you want to get more. Kali Keef is fully dedicated to seeing this through.
